title: Online balancing of vectors with small coordinates
summary: Let $v_1,\ldots,v_T\in B_2^m$ be fixed in advance and revealed sequentially, and assume that $\|v_t\|_\infty\leqslant d^{-1/2}$ for some $d\geqslant 1$ and every $1\leqslant t\leqslant T$. There are absolute constants $L,C,c>0$ and a randomized online signing such that $$\mathbb{P}\left\{\max_{k\leqslant T}\left\|\sum_{t=1}^k\varepsilon_t v_t\right\|_\infty>6L\right\} \leqslant CT\exp\left(-\frac{cd}{\ln^2(ed)}\right).$$ Consequently, constant prefix discrepancy holds with probability at least $1-\varepsilon$ once $d$ is at least…
